title: Format time display as hours and minutes (XhMM)

requirements.text: Update all time duration displays throughout the application (Dashboard, Calendar, Reports pages, and any shared timeFormatting utility) to show time in hours and minutes format (e.g., '7h30' for 7 hours 30 minutes), ensuring both the hours and the two-digit zero-padded minutes are always visible.
acceptanceCriteria: Time durations on the Dashboard page display both hours and minutes (e.g., '7h30', '1h05').
Time durations on the Calendar page display both hours and minutes.
Time durations on the Reports page (table rows and totals) display both hours and minutes.
Minutes are always zero-padded to two digits (e.g., '2h05' not '2h5').
The shared timeFormatting utility (frontend/src/utils/timeFormatting.ts) produces the 'XhMM' format correctly for all callers.
A duration of 0 minutes displays as '0h00'.
A duration with no fractional hours (e.g., exactly 3 hours) displays as '3h00'.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Keep all formatting logic centralized in frontend/src/utils/timeFormatting.ts; do not duplicate logic across pages.
nonGoals: Changing the backend data model or storage format for time entries.
Adding a user-configurable time format preference.
Modifying the Journal page time displays (if any).
